# OrderReview (chat block)

• OrderReview(items (static), fees? (static), payment (static), title? (static), currency? (static))
  - Description: An order review with a hold-to-place-order button.
  - items: The basket lines.
    List of maps keys:
    * name - Item name with size, e.g. "Amul Milk 500 ml".
    * qty - Quantity.
    * price - Line total for this item (not per unit).
  - fees: Extra charges shown muted under the items.
    List of maps keys:
    * label - e.g. "Delivery + taxes".
    * amount - Fee amount.
  - payment: How it is paid, e.g. "UPI ending 4821".
  - title: Optional card title.
  - currency: ISO currency code. Defaults to INR.

OrderReview(items, fees?, payment, title?, currency?) — a basket the user must approve before paying; items = [{name, qty, price}] (price is the LINE total), fees = [{label, amount}], payment = how it is charged ("UPI ending 4821"). Shows total and a hold-to-pay button (1.5 s hold, never a single tap). Use it before any purchase or payment. Events: place_order {items, fees, total, payment} (the user held to pay; only now place the order), edit_order {items}, cancel_order {}. Example: card = OrderReview([{name: "Amul Milk 500 ml", qty: 1, price: 59}], [{label: "Delivery + taxes", amount: 61}], "UPI ending 4821")
